cards.title: What the twin is sent
items: A copy of everything the bridge sends the phone: server.send() writes to the phone and then each mirror (wsserver.py 168–172).

The phone's screen report, checked by screen_report(): mode, expression, tiles, highlighted tile, a toast key, note id, badge and the sensor numbers (protocol.py 238–277). Never a sentence read aloud, never the location.
A mirror that joins gets the phone line, the panel, the open note and the last screen first, so it starts in step (bridge_node.py 198–207).

cards.title: Pictures
items: Frames exist only while she shows (Zeigen) and the facilitator allowed it; otherwise the bridge drops them at once (bridge_node.py 324–339).
They go to the setup page (/api/show.jpg) and to mirrors on loopback only (wsserver.py 174–180); none reaches ROS or disk.
The twin draws one only while the badge is on and it is under 3 s old, else a camera symbol (atl_phone_twin.py 678–719).

cards.title: The other mode
items: With --bridge the twin is the phone itself: it connects to /ws, draws what it is sent, and copies on the mirror socket are ignored except props (atl_phone_twin.py 389–397).
